items.title: NFL WAG Kelly Stafford Addresses Man Who Urged Her to ‘Get a Facelift’
items.summary:
Kelly Stafford responded after a troll on social media criticized her appearance in a makeup-free video tutorial.  

“Get a facelift…you have money,” one commenter wrote on a video posted by Stafford, 37 , on Thursday, November 12.  

Kelly, the wife of Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford , took to her Instagram Story to react by taking the high road and responding with kindness instead. 

“David, my guy…I pray no one ever says this to your beautiful daughter ❤️,” she wrote.  

Clip of Sam Hartman Flirting With Fan’s Mom Resurfaces After ‘Bachelor’ News 

Kelly and Matthew, 38, share four daughters: twins Sawyer and Chandler , 9, Hunter , 8 and Tyler , 6.  

The video on which David commented showed Kelly candidly discussing the pressures she feels on game days.  

“I’m 37, I have four lovely daughters and I spend every Sunday either on a Jumbotron or in front of a lot of people,” Kelly said while sitting in her bathroom.  

Kelly, a Georgia native, exclusively told Us last month that she feels “pressure to look a certain way” while living in Los Angeles. Matthew has been the Rams’ starting quarterback since 2021.  

“It’s normal for everyone to do things and whatnot. I feel that pressure,” she said. “I can only imagine being my daughters growing up here. I would hope that they see it as, ‘Oh, yeah, that’s just what people do here, but we’re good.’ But I think it will be hard. There’s just a lot here.” 

Kelly added, “For me — and I know for my husband, too — we want somewhat of a simpler upbringing for our girls. We already kind of don’t know what we’re doing…
items.t: NFL WAG Kelly Stafford Addresses Man Who Urged Her to ‘Get a Facelift’

items.title: Man Kills Grandson, 12, by Flipping Over Vehicle While Driving Drunk
items.summary:
A West Virginia man was arrested after he killed his 12-year-old grandson when his off-road vehicle flipped over while he was driving drunk.

Michael Hager was charged with DUI causing death after his grandson, Abel Sims, died in the crash on Wednesday, November 11.

The incident took place on Wednesday afternoon when Hager, 51, and Abel 12, were in a side-by-side off-road vehicle just outside of Barboursville, West Virginia, according to a criminal complaint obtained by WSAZ .

While Hager was behind the wheel, he allegedly lost control and the vehicle flipped over with both him and Abel inside of it.

Grandfather Charged With Negligent Homicide After Death of 3-Year-Old 

Authorities then reported to the scene, where they found the vehicle upside down. Abel was then pronounced dead at the scene after he sustained injuries from the crash.

Cabell County Sheriff’s Office deputies reported that Hager smelled like alcohol, he was slurring his words and he nearly fell backward at one point while speaking to authorities. It was also reported that he had a “droopy” and “flushed face,” “droopy” eyelids, “glassy eyes,” a “blank stare and dilated pupils.”

Hager also allegedly would not cooperate with the investigators, which led him to being detained in the back of a police car.

The grandfather was arrested and taken into custody at the Western Regional Jail, where he is being held on a $50,000 bond. Hager is next scheduled to appear in court for a preliminary hearing on Friday, November 20.

It’s not currently clear if Hager has entered a plea or retained legal counsel…
items.t: Man Kills Grandson, 12, by Flipping Over Vehicle While Driving Drunk

The new movie, directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim , follows Holmes, 42, and Evans in the months before the disgraced Theranos founder reported to prison in 2023.

items.title: Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt's Daughter Vivienne Reveals Eating Disorder Battle
items.summary:
Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt ’s daughter Vivienne bared her soul through art while revealing she was hospitalized for an eating disorder earlier this year.

The 18-year-old opened up about her private health battle as part of her Los Angeles art exhibition titled “The Tulip Field: A Gallery on Patience of Patients,” displayed from November 2 through November 8 at Forager Crafts.

“Welcome to The Tulip Field,” Vivienne wrote in a statement at the exhibit via Page Six . “Why is it called The Tulip Field, you ask? Like many, I have struggled with mental health. I have also struggled with an eating disorder.”

She recalled, “At the beginning of this year, I was hospitalized for my ED. I was angry, sick, and very alone.”

Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie's Daughter Vivienne Drops Dad's Last Name 

Vivienne, who is one of Jolie and Pitt’s six children , revealed that with time she embraced the people and the environment at the hospital. (In addition to Vivienne and her twin brother, Knox, the former couple also share kids Maddox, Zahara, Shiloh and Pax.)

“Eventually, however, the kindness and warmth of the kids and staff at the hospital broke down the walls I had built so high,” she wrote. “I have never laughed or cried harder, never been more honest or more myself.”

Vivienne noted that it was the other kids at the hospital who helped her find her strength.

“The other kids there taught me how to be strong when you are at your weakest,” she continued. “It was the worst and best time of my life and I am better for it.”

items.title: RHONY's Erika Hammond Shares Emotional Update on Surrogacy Journey
items.summary:
The Real Housewives of New York City star Erika Hammond is sharing an update on her and husband Ankur Jain ’s journey to parenthood.

“We obviously matched, we were so excited that night,” Erika, 35, said during a recent episode of the RHONY After Show , recalling when the couple found a surrogate. “We, in the next few months, had done an implantation, transfer, and after six weeks found out it wasn’t viable. It’s been tough because, you know, essentially, it was a miscarriage.”

The reality star then shared insight into her relationship with her surrogate and how they’ve coped with the loss.

“Obviously, Ankur and I are very sad, but it’s different because I’m not physically going through it,” she explained. “And I was feeling for her, because I’m like, ‘You’ve been through six weeks, every day, of doing these shots and then now having to go through a miscarriage.’ Like, I kept being like, ‘How are you doing? What can I do for you?’ And she’s feeling bad, because she’s like, ‘I’m so sad for you and Ankur, what can I do?’ And you know, it’s a very special relationship to have that and be there and … she’s an amazing surrogate.”

Erin Andrews' Candid Quotes About Motherhood and Fertility Journey 

Erika said she and Ankur, 36, plan on starting the process again with their surrogate.

“We’re waiting to do another transfer,” she said. “I am currently doing another round of egg freezing — or embryo freezing — right now. Tomorrow I’m doing my procedure, so I’m bloated and a little moody, which maybe is why I’m a little catty today. We’re very excited about doing the transfer.”…

items.title: Landlord Buried Disabled Tenant Below Porch, Told Family He Was Evicted: Cops
items.summary:
A New Mexico landlord is charged with murder after police discovered he allegedly killed and buried his tenant, who disappeared three months ago.

In late October, investigators found Robert Debeary’s body buried below a porch two feet underground outside of an Albuquerque apartment he had been renting from his landlord, Jonah Jeter , according to investigators, per KQRE . He was found buried with a mattress and bed frame.

Debeary, 52, who had survived multiple strokes and was disabled, was last seen on August 12, when security camera footage showed him leaving his apartment, according to court documents viewed by the TV station. His family members told investigators Debeary experienced issues with Jeter ahead of his disappearance.

An investigation revealed Jeter, 33, allegedly shot Debeary in the head on August 12, then concealed his body, per ABQ RAW .

Mom Arrested After Killing Son, Hiding Body Behind Fake Wall in Her House 

He’s charged with murder, three counts of tampering with evidence and aggravated burglary in connection with his death, court records show.

Before Debeary was found dead, Debeary’s family members confronted Jeter at Debeary’s apartment, where they noticed his personal belongings were missing and saw a stain on the floor that appeared to be blood, according to a criminal complaint viewed by ABQ RAW. Jeter allegedly told his family members Debeary hadn’t paid rent and was evicted.

While speaking with NBC affiliate KOB-TV , his son, Micah , recalled entering his father’s apartment amid his disappearance.

“My father is disabled. He had two…

items.title: Johnny Depp Makes Rare Comment About How Fatherhood Changed Him
items.summary:
Johnny Depp gained a new perspective when he became a father.

“There was a great veil lifted,” the Ebenezer star, 63, said during a CBS Mornings appearance on Friday, November 13, “that I had no idea had existed when my first child was born. I literally felt like a veil had been lifted from my vision.”

Depp shares daughter Lily-Rose , 27, and son Jack, 24, with ex Vanessa Paradis .

“Suddenly, I understood exactly what everything had been for,” he continued, explaining that he used to question his acting career before he had kids.

“I never knew the answer to those questions until that veil was lifted, and instantly I knew,” he said. “This is why you’ve made every single move in your life. This is what it’s all about. Even if you’re not particularly, like, a self-obsessed person, it is the first real, selfless moment that one could have, when your child arrives, there’s nothing else in the world that exists.”

Inside Johnny Depp's Son Jack's Private Life as a Bartender in Paris 

When asked whether he’s held onto that “purpose” now that his kids are older, Depp responded, “Oh, for sure.”

Depp and Paradis, 53, were in a relationship from 1998 to 2012, although they never married. The pair welcomed Lily-Rose in 1999, followed by Jack in 2002. The now-exes raised their kids out of the spotlight in France.

Adrian DENNIS / AFP 
 “Now I indeed keep them away from the cameras, because I don’t want our children to be forced to share in our fame against their will,” Paradis told Weekend Knack magazine in 2007. “They didn’t ask for that. Not yet. The day that they will decide…

items.title: Parents Arrested for Child Abuse After Boy, 1, Fell From a 3-Story Balcony
items.summary:
Two parents in North Carolina were arrested after their 1-year-old son was critically injured in a fall from a third-story balcony.

The Wake County Sheriff’s Office confirmed to Us that authorities learned of the incident when deputies received a report that a child fell from an apartment building’s third floor on Saturday, November 7.

The boy allegedly took a plunge after walking past an “unsecured patio door” while his parents, Saniyah Monchaye Person and Jawon Lee Whitley , were sleeping, according to warrants for arrest viewed by People . He “subsequently fell three stories, sustaining a fractured pelvis and a punctured lung.”

The child was then taken to a nearby hospital for treatment for his life-threatening injuries. His current condition is not known.

Mom Arrested After Son Jumped Out of Window, Tested Positive for Cocaine 

Whitley, 28, was arrested on Saturday and has been charged with negligent child abuse resulting in serious bodily injury, according to online records. He is currently being held in custody on a $50,000 bond, and he is next scheduled to appear in court on November 30.

Meanwhile, Person, 26, was arrested three days later on Tuesday, November 10, and was charged with negligent child abuse resulting in serious bodily injury. Online court records indicate that her bond has not yet been set. Person is next scheduled to appear in court on December 3.

It’s not currently clear if Person or Whitley have entered pleas or retained legal counsel following their arrests. The Wake County Sheriff’s Office had no additional updates to share when contacted…
items.t: Parents Arrested for Child Abuse After Boy, 1, Fell From a 3-Story Balcony

Tyler Cameron ‘s Dancing With the Stars elimination still hasn’t fully set in.

“I wish I was there,” he exclusively told Us with a laugh in a joint interview with his fiancée, Tate Madden , on Wednesday, November 11, while promoting their partnership with Blue Buffalo’s Love Made Fresh . “It’s bittersweet.”

The 33-year-old explained, “I’m so excited to be home, like, we are so excited to finish our house, do the nursery, do all these things together, like, start living our life again. But also, [doing that show] was one of the greatest thrills of my life.”

Cameron was paired with Sharna Burgess on season 35 of DWTS , which premiered in September. The pair lasted seven weeks in the competition and were sent home in a heartbreaking double elimination on Horror Movie Night alongside Jackson Olson and Emma Slater .

Tyler Cameron and Tate Madden Admit Wedding Plans Were 'On the Back Burner' 

One week before his final bow in the ballroom, Cameron and Burgess, 41, were joined by Madden, 33, for an emotional contemporary routine on Dedication Night. During the dance, Cameron read a letter to his late mother, Andrea , announcing that he and Madden are expecting their first baby .

“We’re so, so, so grateful that we have that [moment],” Madden told Us . “We always make the joke that our other kids are going to be really upset because I don’t think they’re quite going to get anything as extravagant as this first baby. … It was the coolest, most special [thing], like, the way that we were able to feel like his mom was with us in revealing.”

A Florida man was arrested after he allegedly left a baby in a car for two hours while he gambled inside of a casino.

Gregory Foster has been charged with child neglect following the incident, which took place on Wednesday, November 11, according to Broward County court records viewed by Us .

Foster, 28, was taken into custody at the Broward County Sheriff’s Office’s main jail on $2,500 bond.

Authorities learned of the incident when a Seminole Police Department officer was called to the Seminole Classic Casino in Hollywood, Florida, on Wednesday around 11 a.m., according to an arrest report viewed by Law & Crime . Upon their arrival, the security personnel at the casino directed the officer to a black BMW in the parking lot.

Florida Dad Arrested After Letting Son, 4, Wander Around Busy Road 

The officer noted that the vehicle did not have a driver inside, but they did find that a baby had been “left in the car.” The child was found in a car seat in the middle of the back seat, and the officer noted that the child was not safely buckled in.

The security personnel said that the BMW had been there for “over an hour” by the time the police officer arrived.

Once the officer determined that the child was not moving, they forced their way inside and found that the child “appeared to be sleeping.”

Security at the casino was able to determine that Foster owned the vehicle, and they got in touch with him to discuss the incident. Authorities said that Foster was later found inside the casino “playing at a table.”

items.title: One leg in the air like you just don’t care? Eight classic power poses – and what they really mean
items.summary:
The pose of the moment is eye-catching and a little alarming. But it’s not the first to cause a stir. Here is a history of such stances, from the Angelina Jolie leg flash to Andrew Scott’s insouciant hand-in-pocket

You think you know your culture back to front, all the snooker moves that drove us to this point, and then something happens and you realise you haven’t been paying attention. I’m thinking of the modern celebrity power pose: one leg shooting high in the air, preferably while wearing a ballgown. It has to be a woman. If a man did it, he would be mocking a woman, making his power message: “I’m brave enough, and comfortable enough in my own skin, to mock ladies.” Which is powerful, to be fair.

When women do it – Victoria Beckham started it, Myleene Klass has dabbled, Amanda Holden does it all the time (even standing up) – other women liken them to a cat licking, sorry, grooming its butt. Once, memorably, Taylor Swift posted her cat doing this very thing on Insta. But what is this pose meant to be saying? “I may be a pop star or a TV celebrity, but with my flexibility and muscle tone, I am ready…
items.t: One leg in the air like you just don’t care? Eight classic power poses – and what they really mean
